WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS tc
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.tc) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS aa
  FROM totals t
  WHERE t.tc = (SELECT MIN(t2.tc) FROM totals t2 WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment)
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT aa FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT aa FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT aa FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT aa FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT aa FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT aa FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
          / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PctIncrease
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT 'Biggest' AS ChangeType, Segment, PctIncrease
FROM (SELECT Segment, PctIncrease FROM pct ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lowest', Segment, PctIncrease
FROM (SELECT Segment, PctIncrease FROM pct ORDER BY PctIncrease ASC LIMIT 1);

WITH bond_elements AS (
  SELECT bond_id, MIN(element) AS e1, MAX(element) AS e2
  FROM (
    SELECT c.bond_id, a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.bond_id, a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  )
  GROUP BY bond_id
),
top_combo AS (
  SELECT e1, e2
  FROM bond_elements
  GROUP BY e1, e2
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH perseg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         ) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_early AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
      AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_late AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
      AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((SELECT balance FROM bal_late) - (SELECT balance FROM bal_early)) * 100.0 / (SELECT balance FROM bal_early);

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT p.Segment AS Segment, SUM(p.total_consumption) AS total_consumption, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM per_customer AS p
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, CAST(total_consumption AS REAL) / num_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
  FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, pct FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, pct FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1)

JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p
  ON p.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
 AND p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11);

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player AS p
    WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
    )
    AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday)) < 31
);
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(P.birthday)) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium'

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89

FROM (
  SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS pid FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) ap
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = ap.pid

LIMIT 1

FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name

    SELECT home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,

    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_id FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_match
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_match
)

FROM Player p
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM italy_players)
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa'

FROM Match m

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.A3 LIKE '%Prague%'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) >
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)
);

WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id

JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'

FROM loan l

SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id

JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AND weight_kg = (SELECT MAX(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'))

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT SUM(publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id;

SELECT T1.attribute_name FROM attribute AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.attribute_id INNER JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id WHERE T3.superhero_name = 'Black Panther' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS percentage_female FROM superhero JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'brown'

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence'
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = '30609'
SELECT P.SEX, P.Birthday, E."Examination Date", E.Symptoms FROM Patient P JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE P.ID = '163109';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937' AND L."T-CHO" >= 250
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '+' AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) = 1997 AND e.Thrombosis = '1' AND p.SEX = 'F'
SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Birthday = (SELECT MAX(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)) AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS REAL) / 12 FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
SELECT L.Date, strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL AND l.UA != '';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 18
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory."T-BIL" >= '2.0'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID

LIMIT 1
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND DATE(Date) = '1995-09-04' AND "T-CHO" < 250

SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.[Examination Date] = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT SUM(Patient.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) = '1981'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."ANA Pattern" != 'P'

  AND CAST(substr(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);
SELECT SUM(DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%ITP%') * 100.0 / SUM(DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%SLE%') FROM Patient;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GPT > 60) ORDER BY Birthday
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(T2.LDH AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.UA > 6.5

SELECT AVG(l.UA)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5))
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.UN = 29

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);
SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY P.SEX

SELECT p.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "T-CHO" >= 250);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(T2.TG AS REAL) > 300;

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

ORDER BY p.SEX, p.Birthday DESC;
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50 AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0)

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient

SELECT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992' AND T2.PT < 14;

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type) AS bond_type_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_double_bond, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS num_carcinogenic FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2) WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT b.bond_type

SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS result FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT CAST(SUM(bond_type = '-') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage FROM bond;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.molecule_id) > 5

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(atom_id) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(atom_id) AS cnt FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') GROUP BY molecule_id))

SELECT SUM(m.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-' AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR008') AND element = 'c'
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)

WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT T2.element, T3.bond_type FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ' AND T4.label = 'TR012'
SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'o'

WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         y.CustomerID,
         SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_consumption,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption) AS rnk
  FROM per_customer
),
segment_avgs AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rnk = 1
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM segment_avgs;

         * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')

)

  (SELECT Segment FROM calc ORDER BY pct_increase ASC  LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(strftime('%Y', DATETIME()) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) >= 2013
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015;

SELECT League.name AS league_name, COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
GROUP BY League.id, League.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(height) * 1.0 / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM Player
WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00';

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        )
  );

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
        SELECT SUM(buildUpPlayPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
        FROM Team_Attributes
        WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
          AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN p.player_fifa_api_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992;

SELECT League.name AS league_name,
       SUM(Match.home_team_goal + Match.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
GROUP BY League.id, League.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND ta.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND ta.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND ta.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT SUM(t2.chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(t2.id)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS t2
      WHERE t2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND t2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND t2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY ta.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN (
    SELECT league_id
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2009/2010'
    GROUP BY league_id
    HAVING SUM(home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT id)
         > SUM(away_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT id)
) AS qualifying
    ON League.id = qualifying.league_id;

  / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END)

  SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

   FROM Player_Attributes pa

   WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'

SELECT
  (
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')

   JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC, player_api_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_home_team_goals
FROM Match
WHERE home_team_goal > 0
  AND (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
  ) IN (
    home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5,
    home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10,
    home_player_11
  );

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
     FROM Match m
     WHERE (SELECT p.player_api_id
            FROM Player p
            WHERE p.player_name = 'Daan Smith')
           IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
               m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11))
    +
    (SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
     FROM Match m
     WHERE (SELECT p.player_api_id
            FROM Player p
            WHERE p.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira')
           IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
               m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11))
    AS total_away_team_goal;

WITH young_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE (julianday(datetime('now','localtime')) - julianday(datetime(birthday))) / 365.25 < 31
)
SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Match m
WHERE m.home_player_1  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_2  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_3  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_4  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_5  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_6  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_7  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_8  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_9  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_10 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)
   OR m.home_player_11 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM young_players)

    UNION

    UNION
    SELECT home_player_6 FROM Match WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Belgium') AND home_player_6 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_7 FROM Match WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Belgium') AND home_player_7 IS NOT NULL
    UNION

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match

        SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T
  ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

                                           WHERE name = 'Italy'))
)

    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM ItalyMatch
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM ItalyMatch

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE Player.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND Player.birthday > '1990'

SELECT
  (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6)
  -
  (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN player_api_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes

SELECT ht.team_long_name AS home_team,
       m.home_team_goal,
       at.team_long_name AS away_team,
       m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id

WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A'
  AND Country.name = 'Italy';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE L.name = 'Eredivisie'
  AND C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.name AS league_name, COUNT(m.id) AS num_matches
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY num_matches DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
WHERE t.team_api_id IN (

    FROM Match m

);

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id = (

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account
WHERE district_id IN (

)

FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

FROM client

      FROM district
      WHERE A3 = 'North Bohemia'

  );

JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

FROM disp AS d
WHERE d.client_id IN (

        FROM client

                SELECT district_id

                ORDER BY CAST(A11 AS INTEGER) DESC

                FROM client

                    SELECT district_id
                    FROM district

              )
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp

WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'Disponent'

SELECT DISTINCT loan.account_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON account.account_id = loan.account_id

WHERE l.duration > 12

      FROM loan
      WHERE duration > 12

  AND SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) = '93';

FROM client c

JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id

WHERE CAST(c.issued AS DATE) = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM account a

SELECT a.district_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)

JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id

SELECT disp_id

);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

SELECT d.A2
FROM district d

        WHERE dp.client_id = (

            FROM client c

        )
    )
);

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM client
WHERE client.client_id = (

        FROM loan
        WHERE loan.amount = 98832

);

SELECT a.account_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_pct
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH target AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE status = 'A'
    AND date = '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY loan_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
b1993 AS (
  SELECT t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
  WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
b1998 AS (
  SELECT t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
  WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (b1998.balance - b1993.balance) * 100.0 / b1993.balance AS increase_rate_pct
FROM b1993, b1998;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / SUM(amount) AS pct_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date

JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A2, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT

    district.A3 AS state,
    ((district.A13 - district.A12) / district.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_pct

JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date < '1994-01-01';

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,

JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loan_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)

WHERE account.district_id = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients

        ORDER BY A15 DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_gold_cards

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_amount

    SELECT SUBSTR(date, 1, 7) AS month,
           SUM(amount)        AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND date >= '2021-01-01'
      AND date <  '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(date, 1, 7)
) m;

SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id
FROM disp
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND date LIKE '98%'
      AND amount < (
            SELECT AVG(amount)
            FROM trans
            WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
              AND date LIKE '98%'
          )

JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Grant' AND member.last_name = 'Gilmour';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.amount > 40

SELECT SUM(expense.cost) AS total_expense
FROM expense
WHERE expense.link_to_budget IN (
    SELECT budget.budget_id
    FROM budget
    WHERE budget.link_to_event = (
        SELECT event.event_id
        FROM event
        WHERE event.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
    )
);

SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM member
WHERE member_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE link_to_budget = (
        SELECT budget_id
        FROM budget
        WHERE link_to_event = (
            SELECT event_id
            FROM event
            WHERE event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
        )
    )
);

SELECT member.first_name || ' ' || member.last_name AS full_name, income.source
FROM income
JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE income.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM income);

SELECT ev.event_name
FROM event ev
JOIN budget  b  ON b.link_to_event    = ev.event_id
JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_budget  = b.budget_id
GROUP BY ev.event_id, ev.event_name
HAVING SUM(ex.cost) = (
    SELECT MIN(m.total_cost)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(ex2.cost) AS total_cost
        FROM event ev2
        JOIN budget  b2  ON b2.link_to_event   = ev2.event_id
        JOIN expense ex2 ON ex2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
        GROUP BY ev2.event_id
    ) m
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN expense.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(expense.cost) AS kickoff_pct
FROM expense
JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mj.major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN mj.major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finance_to_physics_ratio
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id;

SELECT source, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM income

SELECT COUNT(*)

JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id

FROM budget

SELECT z.city,
       z.county
FROM income
JOIN member     m ON income.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member      = m.member_id
JOIN event      e ON a.link_to_event       = e.event_id
JOIN zip_code   z ON e.location            = z.zip_code
GROUP BY e.event_id, z.city, z.county
HAVING COUNT(income.income_id) > 40;

WITH member_totals AS (
    SELECT ex.link_to_member,
           SUM(ex.cost) AS total_cost
    FROM expense ex
    JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    GROUP BY ex.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member_totals mt
JOIN member m ON mt.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE mt.total_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_cost) FROM member_totals);

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM expense x
JOIN budget b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(x.cost) * 1.0 < (
    SELECT SUM(x2.cost) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event)
    FROM expense x2
    JOIN budget b2 ON x2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
);

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(exp.cost)
   FROM expense exp
   JOIN budget b ON exp.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
   JOIN event e  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
   WHERE e.type = 'Meeting') * 100.0

  (SELECT COUNT(event_id)
   FROM event
   WHERE type = 'Meeting') AS percentage;

JOIN superhero s ON s.id = hp.hero_id

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE r.race = 'Human'
  AND s.height_cm = 185;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = (SELECT MAX(weight_kg) FROM superhero);

SELECT SUM(publisher.id = 13) * 100.0 / COUNT(publisher.id) AS marvel_percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
WHERE gender_id = (SELECT id FROM gender WHERE gender = 'Male')
  AND weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero);

SELECT superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
GROUP BY superpower.power_name
ORDER BY COUNT(hero_power.hero_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  );

SELECT COUNT(id) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN skin_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM publisher

);

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'durability'

ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id

SELECT ec.colour AS eye_colour,
       hc.colour AS hair_colour,
       sc.colour AS skin_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
LEFT JOIN colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
LEFT JOIN colour sc ON s.skin_colour_id = sc.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id;

SELECT race.race

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)

               JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id

JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id

WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics')
  AND s.weight_kg = (
      SELECT MAX(weight_kg)
      FROM superhero
      WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics')
  );

SELECT AVG(height_cm)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id <> (SELECT id FROM race WHERE race = 'Human')
  AND publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS fastest_count
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.id IN (
    SELECT ha.hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
      AND ha.attribute_value = 100
);

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'DC Comics'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'Marvel Comics'
    ELSE 'Tie'
  END AS publisher_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

FROM attribute
WHERE id IN (
    SELECT attribute_id
    FROM hero_attribute
    WHERE hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Black Panther')
      AND attribute_value = (
          SELECT MIN(attribute_value)
          FROM hero_attribute
          WHERE hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Black Panther')
      )
);

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / COUNT(*)

FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

FROM superhero

JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%'
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'brown'

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value

WHERE ha.hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Aquababy');

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race

FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id

SELECT DISTINCT s.id
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superpower AS sp
WHERE sp.id IN (
    SELECT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id IN (
        SELECT s.id
        FROM superhero AS s
        WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero)
    )
);

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'in-patient'
    ELSE 'outpatient'
  END AS larger_group,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
  / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609'
ORDER BY l.Date;

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT Patient.*
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND Patient.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250)

WITH abnormal_female AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS n
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
    AND l.TP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.TP) <> ''
    AND (CAST(l.TP AS REAL) < 6.0 OR CAST(l.TP AS REAL) > 8.5)
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(ID) AS n FROM Patient
)
SELECT ROUND(abnormal_female.n * 100.0 / total.n, 2) AS pct_female_abnormal_tp
FROM abnormal_female, total;

SELECT AVG(Examination.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE substr(Description, 1, 4) = '1997' AND SEX = 'F' AND Admission = '-';

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Patient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND strftime('%Y', Examination."Examination Date") = '1997'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT Symptoms, Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday = (
        SELECT MAX(Birthday)
        FROM Patient
        WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
    )
    AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
)
AND Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT SUM(male_patients) / 12.0 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', l.Date) AS year_month,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)      AS male_patients
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
      AND p.SEX = 'M'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', l.Date)
);

SELECT (
    SELECT MAX(T1.Date)
    FROM Laboratory AS T1
    WHERE T1.ID = (
        SELECT T2.ID
        FROM Patient AS T2
        WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
        ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
) AS LabDate,
(
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    FROM Patient AS T2
    WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
    ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
    LIMIT 1
) AS AgeAtFirstArrival;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM Laboratory
   JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
   WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
     AND Laboratory.UA <= '8.0') * 1.0
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM Laboratory
   JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
   WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
     AND Laboratory.UA <= '6.5') AS male_to_female_ratio;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', `Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', `First Date`) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS underage_examined_1990_1993
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_elevated_tbil_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
  AND Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
  AND Diagnosis != ''
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(age) AS avg_age_as_of_1999
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           p.ID,
           1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
);

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age, E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);
SELECT `ANA` FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT CASE WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS normal_level
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND `Date` = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT CASE

WHERE p.ID = (

    FROM Laboratory l

    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE `First Date` = '1991-06-13'

SELECT e.Symptoms

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory
   WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18')
     AND Date LIKE '1981-11-%')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory
   WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18')
     AND Date LIKE '1981-12-%') AS decrease_rate;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'

  AND e.`Examination Date` < '1998-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count, GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
   FROM Laboratory
   WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30
     AND UA <= 6.5) * 100.0
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
   FROM Laboratory

        WHERE b.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR346')) AS num_bond_types

SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

    AND (c.atom_id  IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = 'TR024'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2

WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.atom_id) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'

    ) t

    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id

WITH mincons AS (
    SELECT 'SME' AS seg, MIN(y.Consumption) AS minC
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'LAM' AS seg, MIN(y.Consumption) AS minC
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'KAM' AS seg, MIN(y.Consumption) AS minC
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT m.seg AS Segment, c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    JOIN mincons m ON m.seg = c.Segment
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM yearmonth y
          WHERE y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
            AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND y.Consumption = m.minC
      )
),
annual AS (
    SELECT l.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS totalCons,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.CustomerID) AS numCust
    FROM lowest l
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON y.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY l.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, totalCons * 1.0 / numCust AS annualAvg
    FROM annual
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment, (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS Percentage
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct);

    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
start_bal AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN loan_acct l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
end_bal AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN loan_acct l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (CAST(end_bal.balance AS REAL) - CAST(start_bal.balance AS REAL)) * 100.0 / CAST(start_bal.balance AS REAL) AS increase_rate
FROM end_bal, start_bal;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total) AS sum_total,
           COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN min_seg AS m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_total * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID, c.Currency
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
);

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Amount = 634.8 AND Date = '2012-08-25'
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT GasStationID
FROM transactions_1k
GROUP BY GasStationID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(Price) AS total_spent,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Price ELSE 0 END) AS january_2012_spent
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY t.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

SELECT g.Country

ORDER BY t.Price / t.Amount DESC

SELECT T1.CustomerID, T2.Date, T2.Consumption

SELECT (

   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
   ORDER BY pa.date DESC

  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes pa
   JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
   ORDER BY pa.date DESC

  (SELECT pa.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes pa

WITH
donovan AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
      AND date(pa.date) = '2013-07-12'
),
bowery AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
      AND date(pa.date) = '2013-07-12'
)
SELECT (donovan.overall_rating - bowery.overall_rating) * 100.0 / donovan.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM donovan, bowery;
