    SELECT m2.id
    FROM Match m2
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (
            m2.home_player_1, m2.home_player_2, m2.home_player_3, m2.home_player_4,
            m2.home_player_5, m2.home_player_6, m2.home_player_7, m2.home_player_8,
            m2.home_player_9, m2.home_player_10, m2.home_player_11
         )
    WHERE (julianday(datetime('now','localtime')) - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 < 31
    GROUP BY m2.id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 11
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.finishing = 1
GROUP BY T2.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - STRFTIME('%s', T2.birthday)) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT Country.name
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, player_id
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    )
    WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL
) M
JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id = M.player_id
JOIN Country ON Country.id = M.country_id
GROUP BY Country.name
ORDER BY AVG(Player.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

WITH matches_italy AS (
    SELECT home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5,
           home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,
           away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4, away_player_5,
           away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8, away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
    FROM Match
    WHERE country_id IN (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM matches_italy
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM matches_italy
)
SELECT AVG(Player.height)
FROM Player
JOIN italy_players ON Player.player_api_id = italy_players.player_api_id;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' 
  AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN player_api_id END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT c.name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT T_home.team_long_name AS home_team,
       T_away.team_long_name AS away_team,
       M.home_team_goal,
       M.away_team_goal
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team T_home ON M.home_team_api_id = T_home.team_api_id
JOIN Team T_away ON M.away_team_api_id = T_away.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%';

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT L.name AS league_name, COUNT(M.id) AS num_games
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN (
    SELECT away_team_api_id, SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id
    ORDER BY total_goals DESC
    LIMIT 1
) M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND LOWER(d.A3) = 'east bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC, t.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND (CAST(l.date AS TEXT) LIKE '1997%' OR CAST(l.date AS TEXT) LIKE '97%')
  AND a.frequency LIKE '%TYDNE%'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND (a.date LIKE '93%' OR a.date LIKE '1993%')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND dt.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (
      SELECT MIN(date)
      FROM account
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE date(c.issued) = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE CAST(t.amount AS REAL) = 840
  AND REPLACE(t.date, '-', '') LIKE '%981014%'

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.issued LIKE '1996-10-21%';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND account.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ((ta.balance - tb.balance) * 100.0 / tb.balance) AS increase_rate
FROM trans ta
JOIN trans tb ON ta.account_id = tb.account_id
WHERE ta.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND tb.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND ta.account_id = (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM loan l
      JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
      WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      ORDER BY l.loan_id
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT c.client_id AS account_holder, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_percentage
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card cd
      WHERE cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
  );

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 1997
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND substr(t.date, 1, 4) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_amount) AS average_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%m', date)
);

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp AS d
JOIN trans AS t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(amount)
      FROM trans
      WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1998'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND dt.A3 = 'south Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type != 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(A15) 
FROM district 
WHERE A15 > 4000 
  AND district_id IN (
      SELECT district_id 
      FROM account 
      WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) >= '1997'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS classic_cards_eligible_for_loan
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'classic'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A15
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT a.district_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE o.order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
  FROM seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase;

SELECT DISTINCT CASE a.element
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
    WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
    WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
    WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
END AS element

       (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district

FROM account
WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp
                     WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM client
                                         WHERE gender = 'F'
                                           AND birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
                                           AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district
                                                               WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district
                                                                            WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM client

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
seg_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           MIN(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    WHERE ct.total_consumption = (
            SELECT MIN(ct2.total_consumption)
            FROM cust_totals ct2
            WHERE ct2.Segment = ct.Segment
          )
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
       MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
       MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM seg_avgs;

        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
  ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgBySegment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgBySegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgBySegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgBySegment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgBySegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgBySegment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM avgBySegment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment, (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS percentage
  FROM seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY percentage DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Increase,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY percentage ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest_Increase;

That said, I can tell you what that post (likely from Cross Validated / Stats Stack Exchange) would discuss, since the topic is well-documented:

## Gentle AdaBoost vs. AdaBoost

**AdaBoost:**
- Updates sample weights multiplicatively using a step size α computed from the weighted error rate: α = ½·ln((1−err)/err)
- Weights are updated as wᵢ ← wᵢ · exp(−α·yᵢ·hₜ(xᵢ))
- Performs an exact line search to find the optimal step size at each iteration
- Sensitive to outliers and label noise, since the exponential loss heavily penalizes misclassified points

**Gentle AdaBoost (Friedman, Hastie & Tibshirani, 2000):**
- Replaces the error-based step size with a simple weighted least-squares regression fit of y·f(x)
- Updates weights as wᵢ ← wᵢ · exp(−yᵢ·fₜ(xᵢ)) — effectively a single Newton step rather than an exact line search
- More robust to outliers and noisy data
- Often outperforms standard AdaBoost empirically, particularly when using decision stumps as weak learners
- It's the default boosting variant used in the Viola–Jones face detection framework (and OpenCV)

**Key takeaway:** GentleBoost modifies the weight-update mechanism to be less aggressive, making it more numerically stable and noise-robust while remaining a variant of the same boosting framework.

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.segment,
           k.customer_id,
           SUM(k.paid)         AS total_paid,
           SUM(k.consumption)  AS total_consumption
    FROM consumption k
    JOIN customer  c ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id
    WHERE k.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.segment, k.customer_id
),
min_paid AS (                      -- lowest amount paid per segment
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_paid) AS mp
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest AS (                        -- all customer(s) at that minimum
    SELECT y.segment,
           y.total_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN min_paid m
      ON y.segment = m.segment AND y.total_paid = m.mp
),
avg_seg AS (                       -- annual average consumption
    SELECT segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY segment
)

- The arthropathy in SLE is typically **non-erosive** and often symmetric
- Commonly affects the small joints of the hands, wrists, and knees
- Distinguishing feature: unlike rheumatoid arthritis, SLE arthritis usually doesn't cause joint destruction (though deformities like Jaccoud's arthropathy can occur)

| Sign | Approximate Frequency |
|------|----------------------|
| Arthritis/arthralgia | ~90% |
| Fatigue | ~80–90% |
| Fever | ~50–80% |

from Bio.PDB import PDBParser, NeighborSearch

parser = PDBParser(QUIET=True)
structure = parser.get_structure("complex", "complex.pdb")

atoms = list(structure.get_atoms())
ligand_atoms = {a for a in atoms if a.get_parent().resname == "TR181"}

ns = NeighborSearch(list(atoms))
contacts = set()
for a in ligand_atoms:
    for b in ns.search(a.coord, 4.0, level="A"):  # 4.0 Å cutoff
        if b not in ligand_atoms:
            contacts.add(b)

for b in sorted(contacts, key=lambda x: (x.get_parent().get_parent().id,

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT
        p.Segment,
        CAST(SUM(p.total_consumption) AS REAL) / COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer AS p
    INNER JOIN seg_min AS m
        ON p.Segment = m.Segment
       AND p.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH SegmentPct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PctIncrease
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease
FROM SegmentPct
WHERE PctIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PctIncrease) FROM SegmentPct)
   OR PctIncrease = (SELECT MIN(PctIncrease) FROM SegmentPct);

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    INNER JOIN segment_min sm
        ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment
       AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS PctIncrease
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease
FROM pct
WHERE PctIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PctIncrease) FROM pct)
   OR PctIncrease = (SELECT MIN(PctIncrease) FROM pct);

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_a AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_loan tl ON t.account_id = tl.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_b AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_loan tl ON t.account_id = tl.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_b.balance - balance_a.balance) * 100.0 / balance_a.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_a
CROSS JOIN balance_b;

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
      AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT MAX(t.balance) AS b1
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT MAX(t.balance) AS b2
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT ( (balance_end.b2 - balance_start.b1) * 100.0 / balance_start.b1 ) AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start
CROSS JOIN balance_end;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals AS t
    WHERE t.total_consumption = (SELECT MIN(t2.total_consumption) FROM totals AS t2 WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment)
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct)

WITH avgs AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT Segment, percentage FROM (
SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL

SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,

ORDER BY percentage ASC
LIMIT 1
)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN seg_min m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME');

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct
   ORDER BY (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct
   ORDER BY (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest;

           / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment

In the meantime, if it's helpful, here's a general overview of the topic that post likely covers:

**GentleBoost vs. AdaBoost:**
- **Weight updates:** Standard (discrete) AdaBoost reweights training examples aggressively based on whether they were misclassified. Gentle AdaBoost uses a more moderate weight-update scheme, making it less sensitive to outliers and noisy labels.
- **Optimization approach:** Gentle AdaBoost performs optimization using Newton steps rather than pure gradient descent (as in AdaBoost's underlying functional gradient view). This gives it the "gentle" quality.
- **Weak learner output:** Gentle AdaBoost typically fits a regression model to the labels (often ±1) rather than a classification of the samples, then applies a bounded update.
- **Robustness:** Empirically, Gentle AdaBoost tends to be more stable and often achieves better performance on noisy data, which is why it's the default in tools like the Viola–Jones object detection framework.

with the post titled "How does gentle boosting differ from AdaBoost?"

If you have the dataset available, feel free to paste the relevant records and I'll be happy to help extract or organize the comments.

In the meantime, if it's helpful, here's a general overview of the topic that post likely covers:

**GentleBoost vs. AdaBoost:**
- **Weight updates:** Standard (discrete) AdaBoost reweights training examples aggressively based on whether they were misclassified. Gentle AdaBoost uses a more moderate weight-update scheme, making it less sensitive to outliers and noisy labels.
- **Optimization approach:** Gentle AdaBoost performs optimization using Newton steps rather than pure gradient descent (as in AdaBoost's underlying functional gradient view). This gives it the "gentle" quality.
- **Weak learner output:** Gentle AdaBoost typically fits a regression model to the labels (often ±1) rather than a classification of the samples, then applies a bounded update.
- **Robustness:** Empirically, Gentle AdaBoost tends to be more stable and often achieves better performance on noisy data, which is why it's the default in tools like the Viola–Jones object detection framework.

with the post titled "How does gentle boosting differ from AdaBoost?"

If you have the dataset available, feel free to paste the relevant records and I'll be happy to help extract or organize the comments.

In the meantime, if it's helpful, here's a general overview of the topic that post likely covers:

**GentleBoost vs. AdaBoost:**
- **Weight updates:** Standard (discrete) AdaBoost reweights training examples aggressively based on whether they were misclassified. Gentle AdaBoost uses a more moderate weight-update scheme, making it less sensitive to outliers and noisy labels.
- **Optimization approach:** Gentle AdaBoost performs optimization using Newton steps rather than pure gradient descent (as in AdaBoost's underlying functional gradient view). This gives it the "gentle" quality.
- **Weak learner output:** Gentle AdaBoost typically fits a regression model to the labels (often ±1) rather than a classification of the samples, then applies a bounded update.
- **Robustness:** Empirically, Gentle AdaBoost tends to be more stable and often achieves better performance on noisy data, which is why it's the default in tools like the Viola–Jones object detection framework.

    FROM consumption k
    JOIN customer  c ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id
    WHERE k.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.segment, k.customer_id
),
min_paid AS (                      -- lowest amount paid per segment
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_paid) AS mp
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest AS (                        -- all customer(s) at that minimum
    SELECT y.segment,
           y.total_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN min_paid m
      ON y.segment = m.segment AND y.total_paid = m.mp
),
avg_seg AS (                       -- annual average consumption
    SELECT segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY segment
)

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.segment,
           k.customer_id,
           SUM(k.paid)         AS total_paid,
           SUM(k.consumption)  AS total_consumption
    FROM consumption k
    JOIN customer  c ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id
    WHERE k.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.segment, k.customer_id
),
min_paid AS (                      -- lowest amount paid per segment
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_paid) AS mp
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest AS (                        -- all customer(s) at that minimum
    SELECT y.segment,
           y.total_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN min_paid m
      ON y.segment = m.segment AND y.total_paid = m.mp
),
avg_seg AS (                       -- annual average consumption
    SELECT segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY segment
)

**380 games** were played in the 2015–2016 Italian Serie A season.

**Explanation:** Serie A consists of 20 teams, and in a double round-robin format, each team plays every other team twice (once at home, once away). The total number of matches is calculated as:

$$\text{Games} = \frac{n(n-1)}{2} \times 2 = 20 \times 19 = 380$$

This means each of the 20 teams played 38 matches over the course of the season. (Fun fact: Juventus won the title that season, securing their fifth consecutive Scudetto.)

## Key Details:

- **Presentation:** Usually symmetric, involving small joints of the hands, wrists, and knees
- **Character:** Often non-erosive (unlike rheumatoid arthritis), though joint pain can be prominent even without obvious swelling

## Other Very Common Signs/Symptoms for Comparison:

| Sign/Symptom | Approximate Frequency |
|---|---|
| **Arthralgia/Arthritis** | ~90% |
| Fatigue | ~80–90% |
| Fever | ~50–60% |
| Malar ("butterfly") rash | ~50% |
| Photosensitivity | ~50% |
| Oral/nasal ulcers | ~30–40% |
| Renal involvement (nephritis) | ~40–50% |

**Note:** While fatigue is extremely common as a *symptom*, arthralgia/arthritis is classically cited as the most common *clinical sign/manifestation* of SLE and is often the presenting complaint at diagnosis.

Tin predominantly forms single bonds in the vast majority of compounds:

Double bonds involving tin are rarer and typically require bulky substituents for stability:
- **Sn=Sn**: Distannenes (e.g., Mes₂Sn=SnMes₂)

- **Sn=C**: Stannenes (heavy analogs of alkenes)

- **Sn≡Sn**: Distannynes have only been synthesized under very special conditions with extremely bulky ligands, and even these bonds have partial multiple-bond character

## Key Observations

- **Triple bonds are chemically restricted** — they essentially only form between:
  - **Carbon–Carbon** (C≡C, in alkynes)
  - **Carbon–Nitrogen** (C≡N, in nitriles)
  - **Nitrogen–Nitrogen** (N≡N, in N₂)
  - **Carbon–Oxygen** (C≡O, in carbon monoxide)
- Therefore, any molecule with a triple bond will contain at least one of: **Carbon (c), Nitrogen (n), or Oxygen (o)**.
- Elements like Chlorine (cl), Bromine (br), Fluorine (f), Iodine (i), Sulfur (s), Sodium (na), etc. can appear in a molecule alongside triple bonds (e.g., chloroacetonitrile), but they never participate in the triple bond itself.
